scene_description: A woman with long hair stands with her back to the viewer at what appears to be an airport observation area. She is holding a handbag and standing next to a rolling suitcase. In the sky above, an airplane is flying away.

questions.question: What do you see flying in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up at the top part of the picture in the sky.

questions.question: What is the big bag on wheels called? What do you see next to the lady?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bag with wheels sitting on the ground near the lady.

questions.question: What is the lady doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the lady's body — is she moving or standing still? What is she facing?

questions.question: Where is the airplane?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top of the picture and find the airplane.

questions.question: The lady has a suitcase. What might she be getting ready to do?
questions.sentence_frame: She might be getting ready to ___.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the suitcase and the airplane — think about when people use suitcases.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on an airplane? Where did you go?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled somewhere far away.
